description: Holds factory product requisition header records (defined in the EF Core model), linked to department, factories, stores.
business_purpose: Used to track and report factory product requisition header records, including approval status, amounts and quantities, for the Factory & Inventory area.
record_granularity: One row represents one factory product requisition header.

Each factory product requisition header references one department (department).
Each factory product requisition header references one factories (factory).

business_rules: Deleted records (is_deleted = 1) should normally be excluded from reporting.
Approval state is tracked with is_approved, is_rejected; a record with neither flag set is typically still pending.
is_closed = 1 marks the record as closed.
created_date is the preferred date column for period-based reporting.
Use total_amount / total_items for monetary or quantity totals.
Columns status classify the record; check the distinct values before filtering on them.
Join to Department, Factories, Stores, Users through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
FactoryProductRequisitionHeader is defined in the EF Core model but was not found in the connected database, so it may not be deployed there.

known_issues: total_amount is stored as floating point, so sums can carry small rounding differences.
total_amount, total_items are nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.

query_notes: Do not generate SQL against FactoryProductRequisitionHeader: no table or view with this name exists in the connected database.
Always filter is_deleted = 0 unless deleted records are explicitly requested.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting factory product requisition header records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(total_amount) for totals of total amount.
To resolve names, join on: departmentid = Department.id; factoryid = Factories.id; storeid = Stores.id; supervisorId = Users.Id.
Defined in the EF Core model but not found in the connected database; confirm it has been migrated before relying on it.
